alt: Our diagram of the reported GTA 6 ammo refill trick: give a long gun to your partner, take it back, and the poster says the magazine refills. Unconfirmed. Not a game screenshot.

data.title: Reported refill trick

steps.title: Give a long gun
steps.body: Poster says: hand it to your partner.

steps.title: Take it back
steps.body: Poster says: take the same gun back.

steps.title: Full magazine?
steps.body: Poster says the loaded mag refills.

data.tip: Unconfirmed: one player report (u/Sinx0x, 25 Nov 2026). Not tested by us.
